description: This file defines a custom layout manager class 'BetterFlowLayout' that extends Java's standard FlowLayout. It overrides methods to compute preferred and minimum layout sizes based on the components within a container, providing a potentially improved or customized layout behavior.

classes.name: BetterFlowLayout
classes.description: A custom layout manager extending FlowLayout that calculates preferred and minimum sizes of a container based on its components, with an improved sizing algorithm.

methods.name: BetterFlowLayout
methods.description: Constructs a BetterFlowLayout with default alignment.

methods.name: BetterFlowLayout
methods.description: Constructs a BetterFlowLayout with specified alignment.

methods.name: BetterFlowLayout
methods.description: Constructs a BetterFlowLayout with specified alignment, horizontal gap, and vertical gap.

methods.name: preferredLayoutSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred size of the container based on the custom algorithm.

methods.name: minimumLayoutSize
methods.description: Returns the minimum size of the container, identical to preferred size in this implementation.

methods.name: betterPreferredSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns a Dimension representing the optimal size for the container based on its visible components, considering wrapping layout logic.
